description: This file defines the class Ip within the Opencart admin model extension for fraud detection. It handles creating, deleting, adding, removing, and querying IP addresses flagged for fraud within the database.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: A model class managing fraudulent IP addresses, allowing installation, removal, addition, and querying of IPs in the fraud IPs database table.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'fraud_ip' table in the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'fraud_ip' table from the database.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Inserts a new IP address into the fraud IPs table.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Deletes an IP address from the fraud IPs table.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of fraud IPs with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Returns the total number of IP addresses flagged for fraud.

methods.name: getTotalIpsByIp
methods.description: Returns the count of occurrences of a specific IP in the fraud list.
